snippet.title: Docked Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
All hands on deck! ⚓🚢

Introducing Docked! A new realistic port simulation game from Saber Interactive.

Step into the boots of a longshoreman and see what it takes to manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive. 

Coming soon to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Wishlist now: http://saber.games/Docked

⚫️Steam: https://sabr.gg/DockedSteam
🔵PlayStation 5: https://sabr.gg/DockedPS
🟢Xbox Series X|S: https://sabr.gg/DockedXbox
